name: Wrap-ups
description: What happened today, last week, last month: the numbers from the same registry the bot answers from (people, calls, deals and cash from GHL, bookings and dials from the ledger), worded by the report step's layout (a line only for a number that is not zero, a section only with a line, one line when nothing happened; D76), posted to the reports channel on the company's schedule. Every word, the numbers read (metrics), per-closer and per-setter lines (breakdowns) and whether a week or month is the one just ended or the one so far (period) are on the report step (D88).

heading.weekly: *Last week — {{report.start | date:LLL d}} to {{report.end | date:LLL d}}*
heading.weekly_to_date: *This week so far — {{report.start | date:LLL d}} to {{report.end | date:LLL d}}*

sections.title: *Bookings*
lines: {{report.n.booked | each:"Calls booked: {{item}}"}}{{report.n.booked_self | each:" · self-booked {{item}}"}}{{report.n.booked_set | each:" · setter-booked {{item}}"}}

sections.title: *Sales calls*
lines: {{report.calls.booked | each:"Calls due: {{item}}"}}{{report.calls.showed | each:" · showed {{item}}"}}{{report.calls.noshow | each:" · no-show {{item}}"}}{{report.calls.cancelled | each:" · cancelled {{item}}"}}{{report.calls.missing | each:" · not filed {{item}}"}}{{report.rates.show_rate | each:" · show rate {{item}}%"}}

sections.title: *Deals*
lines: {{report.n.closes | each:"Closes: {{item}}"}}{{report.n.revenue | each:" · revenue ${{item | money:0}}"}}{{report.rates.close_rate | each:" · close rate {{item}}%"}}

sections.title: *Cash*
lines: {{report.money_moved | each:"Cash collected: ${{report.raw.cash_collected | default:0 | money:0}}"}}{{report.n.refunds | each:" · refunds ${{item | money:0}}"}}

sections.title: *What they said*
lines: {{report.said | each:"*{{item.label}}*{{item.top | each:\"\\n    • {{item.answer}}: {{item.count}}\" | join:\"\"}}{{item.rest | nonzero | each:\"\\n    • {{item}} spread across {{parent.rest_kinds | plural:\\\"other answer\\\"}}\"}}" | join:"\n"}}

sections.title: *By closer*
lines: {{report.by.closer | each:"{{item.name}}: {{item.values.booked | default:0}} booked · {{item.values.showed | default:0}} showed · {{item.values.deals_won | default:0}} won · ${{item.values.revenue | default:0 | money:0}} revenue" | join:"\n"}}

sections.title: *By setter*
lines: {{report.by.setter | each:"{{item.name}}: {{item.values.dials | default:0}} dials · {{item.values.connects | default:0}} connected · {{item.values.calls_set | default:0}} set · {{item.values.booked_set | default:0}} booked" | join:"\n"}}
